mapper.insert: insert into lift_machine(heartbeat_time, machine_code, location_name, use_unit, maintenance_unit, factory_id, machine_name, machine_id, rescue_link, registration_unit, state, community_id, brand) values (#{heartbeatTime}, #{machineCode}, #{locationName}, #{useUnit}, #{maintenanceUnit}, #{factoryId}, #{machineName}, #{machineId}, #{rescueLink}, #{registrationUnit}, #{state}, #{communityId}, #{brand})
